details: Both Bitcoin and Ethereum experienced significant price declines, with Bitcoin falling below $81,000 and Ethereum below $2,400, in response to hotter-than-forecast US Producer Price Index (PPI) data. This macroeconomic shock triggered a broad risk-off sentiment across the crypto markets, leading to substantial liquidations.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum Plunge Following Higher-Than-Expected US Inflation

details: US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) registered net outflows for the week, with approximately $262 million withdrawn. This trend reversed earlier inflows and contributed to the overall negative sentiment. In contrast, XRP ETFs managed to attract positive inflows, bucking the broader market outflow trend.
title: Bitcoin Spot ETFs Record Outflows, XRP Funds Show Resilience

details: Ripple Prime has launched 24/7 real-world asset (RWA) perpetual swaps, deepening its push into Wall Street and institutional services. This move aims to bring greater liquidity and accessibility for institutional clients looking to engage with tokenized assets around the clock.
title: Ripple Introduces 24/7 Real-World Asset Swaps for Institutions

details: Abstract, an Ethereum Layer 2 solution backed by Pudgy Penguins, is reportedly shutting down after experiencing significant financial losses, estimated to be in the tens of millions. This development highlights the challenges faced by new projects in the competitive Layer 2 ecosystem.
title: Pudgy Penguins-Backed Ethereum L2 Abstract to Cease Operations

details: Investment firm VanEck has canceled its plans for a Lido staked Ethereum (ETH) ETF. The reasons for the withdrawal were not immediately detailed, but this decision reflects a cautious approach or potential regulatory hurdles in offering staked crypto investment products.
title: VanEck Withdraws Application for Lido Staked Ethereum ETF
